semantic_correction_reason: Trader supplied additional real-trade screenshots and direct labels before clean v2.4 sealed PnL. The correction separates ordinary momentum from true displacement; makes momentum the rejection trigger after doji/pin/inside/shrinking or equivalent zone stories; changes a normal breakout so the first completed print beyond the key zone is setup only and a subsequent momentum candle confirms; adds weak-break pullback -> 15m three-bar continuation; freezes exactly two pre-break early-entry exceptions; preserves first-reaction TP ordering; and prevents fresh range-day entry zones from being crowded against the active pre-open range.

active_map_policy.range_day_fresh_entry_zone_rule: When the causal pre-open structure is MIXED/ranging, preserve nearby structure as reaction/TP context but remove fresh-entry authorization from zones that do not leave the already-frozen minimum room from the active range edge.

key_level_semantics.inflection_rule: A valid zone may reject, reclaim, break, accept, retest or later flip role; touching it does not predict direction.

candlestick_semantics.legacy_pattern_label_note: The recognizer's historical BULLISH/BEARISH_LONG_BODY_DISPLACEMENT label is a pattern-taxonomy name only. Executable true displacement is separately defined by the entry-fidelity contract as momentum plus range expansion; not every strong red/green momentum candle is displacement.

entry_trigger_semantics.momentum_candle: Directional control candle using frozen body/close geometry; range expansion is not required.
entry_trigger_semantics.rejection_entry: authorized key zone -> valid rejection/control story -> directional momentum trigger
entry_trigger_semantics.normal_breakout: first completed print beyond zone is setup only -> subsequent momentum candle confirms
entry_trigger_semantics.weak_breakout: weak first break -> controlled pullback -> completed 15m three-bar continuation

directional_examples.support_rejection_long: price reaches support; doji/pin/inside/shrinking or equivalent rejection story shows sellers failing; bullish momentum triggers
directional_examples.resistance_rejection_short: price reaches resistance; doji/pin/inside/shrinking or equivalent rejection story shows buyers failing; bearish momentum triggers
directional_examples.resistance_breakout_long: first completed print above resistance is setup; next bullish momentum can confirm, or a weak break may pull back and later complete the 15m three-bar continuation
directional_examples.support_breakout_short: first completed print below support is setup; next bearish momentum can confirm, or a weak break may pull back and later complete the 15m three-bar continuation
directional_examples.resistance_break_retest_long: resistance is genuinely broken and accepted, retests as support, then bullish momentum/control evidence confirms
directional_examples.support_break_retest_short: support is genuinely broken and accepted, retests as resistance, then bearish momentum/control evidence confirms
directional_examples.prebreak_long_exception: repeat-test momentum attack or genuine displacement sequence may trigger before a completed print above resistance
directional_examples.prebreak_short_exception: repeat-test momentum attack or genuine displacement sequence may trigger before a completed print below support

target_semantics.first_reaction_priority: Whichever valid meaningful reaction area has the nearest physical first-contact edge in the trade direction owns the TP decision. A nearer 5m liquidity cluster outranks a farther 15m FVG; a nearer active 15m FVG outranks a farther liquidity cluster. No farther feature may leapfrog the nearer meaningful reaction area.
target_semantics.overlap_policy: When a 5m cluster or FVG is internal to the already-winning broad reaction area, it may refine TP only inside that area; it may not move the target beyond the first-reaction owner.
target_semantics.real_user_example_2026_08_18: Trader supplied real screenshots where the liquidity cluster sat in front of the FVG in the trade direction; price reacted at the cluster and did not need to enter the farther FVG, so the cluster owned TP.

anti_overfit.reason: Entry-fidelity, range-room, zone-first candle semantics and first-reaction TP hierarchy are frozen before clean v2.4 PnL. No new numeric entry threshold was selected from performance; the new rules reuse existing frozen geometry/room parameters and direct trader labels.
